## OwnCode v0.4.0

This release adds fast processing controls, automatic permission approval, and combined worker throughput. It also removes command delays caused by shared shell queues.

### New controls

- `/fast on|off` requests priority or standard processing for supported OpenAI and ChatGPT calls, including workers. It keeps the selected model and reasoning level. Provider access and higher usage rates can apply.
- `/yolo on|off` enables or disables automatic tool approvals for the current app run, including workers. Plan restrictions, worker ownership rules, and explicit user questions remain active.
- Both commands toggle without arguments, appear in the command palette, and show active status near the input. Both reset on restart.

### Worker visibility

- The TPS row combines active parent and worker streams for the current conversation. Finished workers and unrelated chats do not inflate the total.
- Live TPS remains an estimate. Provider token counts replace estimates at completion when available.
- Subagent cards and `/agents` now show the recorded model and reasoning level. Reasoning remains visible with long model names and narrow panels.

### Execution fixes

- Workers use separate persistent shells, so a long command no longer blocks every worker's commands.
- Shell cancellation stops the affected process group. Queued requests honor cancellation and timeout limits.
- Free worker slots take the next queued task immediately.
- Approved tool requests bypass unrelated pending permission prompts.
- Reasoning deltas now reach message storage and throughput accounting.
- Tool execution errors reach the model as failed results instead of empty successes.

### Validation

- Full race test suite, build, and `go vet` passed.
- Tests cover permission toggles, provider request fields, worker scheduling, shell isolation, cancellation, and combined throughput.
- A local three-command benchmark measured approximately 143 ms with a shared shell and 50 ms with separate shells. This measures command scheduling, not model generation speed.
- Validation used local fixtures without live model calls.

### Install or upgrade

```sh
brew update
brew install muratmirgun/tap/owncode
# Existing installations:
brew upgrade owncode
```

Archives and Linux packages are available below. The download installer verifies release checksums. macOS binaries are not signed or notarized.
